title: Mark done
purpose: Mark an open action on a nonconformance done and record what was done.
summary: Mark an open action done and say what was done. The person the action is assigned to, the record's owner or a supervisor can do this.

tasks.title: Mark an action done
steps: In the Actions table on the record select [[Mark done]] on the action.
Describe [[What was done]] and select [[Mark done]].

tasks.title: Find your actions to finish
steps: Open [[Corrective actions]], set [[Show]] to [[Mine]] and select the nonconformance number.

good_to_know: Marking done cannot be undone. A done action can no longer be edited or cancelled.
The record can close only when no action is open, so finishing actions moves it toward closing.
The actions of a closed record do not change.
If the record changed after you opened the form, saving is refused and your text kept. Reload and try again.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Opens from Mark done on an action of the record, as a dialog or a full page. The person the action is assigned to, the record's owner or a supervisor (the admin role included) may open it; anyone else is refused: Its assignee, the owner or a supervisor marks an action done. While the optional nonconformance module is off it answers Not found.

items.label: Action, Person, Due
items.description: The action you are finishing: its text, who does it and its due date.

items.label: What was done
items.description: Required, up to 2,000 characters. Shown under Finished in the record's Actions table.

items.label: Mark done
items.description: Sets the action to Done, records you and the time, and confirms Action marked done. The history records Action marked done.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the record without changing anything.

items.label: Refusals
items.description: An action already done or cancelled: This action is already finished. A closed record: A closed nonconformance does not change. A supervisor can reopen it.

items.label: Stale form
items.description: This nonconformance changed after you opened it. Reload it and review the latest details. Any change to the record, its actions or its linked tickets counts.
